segment.source: I've got some nice huntin' gear if ya want to take a look, stranger, and a bunch of other random stuff I scavenged.<end>
segment.target: I've got some nice huntin' gear if ya want to take a look, stranger, and a bunch of other random stuff I scavenged.<end>

segment.source: Show me what you got, old timer. ::Barter.::<end>
segment.target: Show me what you got, old timer. ::Barter.::<end>

segment.source: Would you happen to by any chance have an Armadillo class drill rotor circuit board?<end>
segment.target: Would you happen to by any chance have an Armadillo class drill rotor circuit board?<end>

segment.source: I dunno what that is, $(#son/young lady), but I'm pretty sure I ain't have none of that.<end>
segment.target: I dunno what that is, $(#son/young lady), but I'm pretty sure I ain't have none of that.<end>

segment.source: Any idea who might have some drill parts around here?<end>
segment.target: Any idea who might have some drill parts around here?<end>

segment.source: Well, you could try the Depot to the west. Or maybe the docks, they're to the east. You'll find all sorts of junk there.<end>
segment.target: Well, you could try the Depot to the west. Or maybe the docks, they're to the east. You'll find all sorts of junk there.<end>

segment.source: Merchants here only accept stygian coins? How do I get some of those?<end>
segment.target: Merchants here only accept stygian coins? How do I get some of those?<end>

segment.source: Some guy at the docks will sell you charons for other monies, or so I heard.<end>
segment.target: Some guy at the docks will sell you charons for other monies, or so I heard.<end>

segment.source: What's there to hunt in the nearby caves?<end>
segment.target: What's there to hunt in the nearby caves?<end>

segment.source: Them beetles too, but they taste terrible.<end>
segment.target: Them beetles too, but they taste terrible.<end>

segment.source: I was really hungry once and had to eat a bit of it. The only part ya can actually eat is the brain. First when ya take a bite, it ain't so bad, but then...<end>
segment.target: I was really hungry once and had to eat a bit of it. The only part ya can actually eat is the brain. First when ya take a bite, it ain't so bad, but then...<end>

segment.source: As soon as ya catch one of 'em thin blue veins or they burst and spill out... ugh, so bitter. I could taste it in my mouth fer weeks!<end>
